name: TODO
description: Lists the TODO, FIXME, HACK and XXX comments of the project, grouped by file or by tag, and hands any of them to an agent in one click.
author: Hangar

gallery.permissionsSummary: Runs one declared command, a Node script that only reads the files of the workspace that .gitignore leaves in (and runs `git blame` on one file when you ask for its author); opens a file in the preview when you click; keeps the last scan in the kit's own data folder; and sends a comment to an agent of the workspace only when you click.

scan.description: Finds the TODO, FIXME, HACK and XXX comments in the files of the workspace, skipping .git, node_modules, target, dist and what .gitignore lists. With a file, lists that file's comments with their author and age by git blame; with an empty value, scans everything. Reads only: it writes and changes nothing.

file.description: A path in the workspace to read the authors of, or empty to scan every file
